row.title: OpenAlex refuses Workers even in the polite pool; Europe PMC is the second route
row.body: Beat 2 (17:23 UTC, after the mailto polite-pool fix) still got HTTP 429 on every OpenAlex call from the ultrastable-replication-ledger Worker: OpenAlex limits by address and Workers share theirs. checkFinding now falls back to Europe PMC (CITES search, no key) and reads its records with the same verbatim-quote reader; the OpenAlex error now carries the response text so the cause is visible on /api/beats.

title: OpenAlex refuses Workers even in the polite pool; Europe PMC is the second route
